description: Evaluates feature engineering quality for balance torque classification tasks

criteria.question: Did the pipeline fail to execute? (True if there are runtime errors OR if no valid accuracy/F1 metrics are available in the output)

schema.description: True if pipeline crashed or produced no valid metrics

criteria.question: What is the test set accuracy as a float between 0 and 1? Return null if the pipeline failed or produced no metrics.

schema.description: Test accuracy (0-1 range), or null if unavailable

criteria.question: What is the test set macro F1 score as a float between 0 and 1? Return null if the pipeline failed or produced no metrics.

schema.description: Macro F1 score (0-1 range), or null if unavailable

criteria.question: List the exact column/feature names that were passed to the model for training (i.e., the columns in X_train or equivalent). If the pipeline failed, return an empty list.

schema.description: Feature column names used for model training

criteria.question: Did the pipeline compute individual torque features for each side? Specifically, did it compute Left Torque = Left Weight × Left Distance AND Right Torque = Right Weight × Right Distance (or any mathematically equivalent computation)?

schema.description: True if both left and right torque features were computed

criteria.question: Did the pipeline compute a torque difference feature representing net torque? For example: Left Torque - Right Torque, or Torque Difference, or any equivalent subtraction between the two side torques.

schema.description: True if a torque difference/net torque feature was created

criteria.question: If the pipeline failed, briefly describe the root cause error in one sentence (e.g. 'ValueError: could not convert string to float', 'KeyError: column not found'). Return null if the pipeline succeeded.

schema.description: Short description of why the pipeline failed, or null if it succeeded
